notes: Fix: joining a game no longer crashes Roblox. The load-clock guard was reading a zero offset instead of testing it, so every script load took a null dereference the moment a place loaded.
Fix: the executor now stands itself down cleanly when Roblox is not the build its offsets were derived from, instead of faulting on a null task scheduler.
Requires Roblox 0.741.0.7411056. If you are on a different build, re-run the install script — it pins the right one.
The payload now ships as a GitHub release asset rather than an anonymous file host, so the download no longer depends on a third-party host staying up.
